name: visual_question_answering
description: Answer questions about images using visual question answering models from Hugging Face.

input_parameters.name: image_path
input_parameters.description: Path to the image file to analyze

input_parameters.name: question
input_parameters.description: Question to ask about the image
input_parameters.example: What color is the car in the image?

input_parameters.name: model_name
input_parameters.description: HuggingFace model ID for visual question answering

input_parameters.name: api_token
input_parameters.description: HuggingFace API token (optional, will use config if not provided)

examples.description: Ask about objects in an image

input.question: What appliances can you see in this kitchen?
What types of flowers are visible and what colors are they?
What sport is being played in this image?
